Class Octree<T>

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.spatial.Octree<T>
Type Parameters:
T - Type of element
All Implemented Interfaces:
SpatialPartition<T>
public class Octree<T> extends Object implements SpatialPartition<T>
A sparse, point-region Octree implementation. Thread-safe for read/write operations if synchronized externally or used with appropriate locking. Current implementation uses simple synchronized methods for basic thread safety.
